responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation-URL companion table for the VAX ELF-specific option definition file. In GCC’s option metadata system, this .opt.urls file maps options declared in elf.opt to anchors in the generated manuals so diagnostics, option help, or tooling can attach the correct manual location for ELF subtarget switches; in this case it is the sidecar for the VAX ELF option set rather than a file that defines options or backend behavior itself.
